nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build for the HipCortex web server binary. Builder stage uses rust:1.87-bookworm to compile the webserver binary with the web-server and petgraph_backend features (no external DB deps). Runtime stage uses debian:bookworm-slim, drops to a non-root hipcortex user, exposes port 3030, and includes a curl-based health check.

nodes.name: docker-compose.dev.yml

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Production Docker Compose stack defining four services: hipcortex (REST API on 3030), postgres:15-alpine (with migrations auto-applied via docker-entrypoint-initdb.d), redis:7-alpine (append-only, LRU eviction), and an optional dashboard service behind the dashboard profile. All services have health checks and restart-unless-stopped policies.

nodes.name: HuggingFace Space Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Dockerfile that builds the HipCortex web server binary from source using Rust 1.78 with only the `web-server` and `petgraph_backend` features enabled, then packages the release binary into a minimal Debian Bookworm slim image. The container exposes port 3030 and launches the `hipcortex-webserver` binary with `RUST_LOG=info`. This targets a HuggingFace Spaces deployment of the REST API surface.

nodes.name: CI
nodes.summary: Primary continuous integration pipeline triggered on push/PR to main. Runs six parallel jobs: core library build+test (unit, integration, property suites) with and without tokio, web-server binary build, latency+token-reduction benchmarks (PR-only, posts comment), Python SDK unit tests, host MCP installer E2E smoke tests on Ubuntu and Windows, and a standalone token-reduction benchmark asserting 80%+ savings.

nodes.name: Cognitive OS Token Optimization Verification
nodes.summary: Lightweight pipeline triggered on push/PR/manual dispatch that verifies Headroom and Caveman token-compression savings offline (no live Rust server). Runs a single Python harness (`tests/verify_token_optimization.py`) asserting Top-5/Top-3 compression math (59-89% / 70-92% savings) using Python stdlib only.

nodes.name: Publish npm package
nodes.summary: Publishes the HipCortex TypeScript SDK (`sdk/typescript`) to npm on GitHub Release publication or manual dispatch. Installs Node 20 dependencies, runs tests, builds, then publishes publicly with `NPM_TOKEN`; supports a dry-run mode via `workflow_dispatch` input that runs `npm pack --dry-run` instead of publishing.

nodes.name: Publish Python SDK to PyPI
nodes.summary: Builds and publishes the HipCortex Python SDK (`sdk/python`) to PyPI on GitHub Release or manual dispatch. Uses `python -m build` to produce wheel+sdist, then `pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish` with OIDC id-token permissions or `PYPI_API_TOKEN`; publish step is gated to release events only so manual triggers build without publishing.

nodes.name: Release Binaries
nodes.summary: Cross-platform binary release pipeline triggered on GitHub Release or manual dispatch. The `build-release` job compiles the `webserver` binary for five targets (linux-amd64, linux-arm64 via `cross`, macos-amd64, macos-arm64, windows-amd64) and uploads each as a release asset and workflow artifact. A dependent `package-vsix` job downloads all binaries, stages them into `vscode-extension/server/`, builds the VS Code extension with `vsce package`, and uploads the resulting VSIX to both the release and as an artifact.

nodes.name: .env.example

nodes.label: SafetyGuardrail (src/safety_guardrail.rs)

Also manages: `violation_log` (HashMap<op_context, Vec<reason>>), `snapshots` (audit trail as JSON), `rollback` (eprintln hook). nodes.label: memory_processor
nodes.summary: Small utility struct `MemoryProcessor` with a single public method `deduplicate(&mut Vec<MemoryRecord>)` that uses a UUID `HashSet` to retain only the first occurrence of each record. Used by the CLI `Add` command after inserting a record to keep the on-disk store deduplicated.

nodes.label: memory_record
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical `MemoryRecord` data model and the `MemoryType` enum (Temporal, Symbolic, Procedural, Reflexion, Perception). `MemoryRecord` carries: UUID id, record_type, timestamp, actor/action/target, serde_json metadata, SHA-256 integrity hash (auto-computed on construction via `compute_hash`), content_hash, access_count, last_accessed, relevance_score (f64), expires_at (Unix timestamp), confidence (f32, default 1.0), source (Option<String>), version (u32), tags (Vec<String>), priority (pinned/high/normal/low), and status (active/quarantine/archived). Provides `mark_accessed`, `update_relevance_score`, `calculate_decay_factor` (access-weighted exponential), `should_prune`, `similarity_score`, and typed metadata get/set helpers. The SHA-256 integrity hash is recomputed on every metadata mutation.

nodes.label: memory_store
nodes.summary: Persistence facade for MemoryRecord collections. Generic over `MemoryBackend` (trait from `persistence` module). Maintains an in-memory `Vec<MemoryRecord>`, three `IndexMap` inverted indices (actor/action/target), a write-ahead `VecDeque` buffer with configurable batch_size, a Merkle-chained `AuditLog`, a `SourceTrustRegistry`, optional `EmbeddingProvider`, and a `namespace` for multi-tenant tag isolation. Constructors: `new` (plain JSONL FileBackend), `new_with_options` (compression option), `new_encrypted` (AES-GCM), `new_encrypted_envelope` (envelope encryption), `new_in_memory` (zero-I/O for tests), `new_rocksdb` (feature-gated `rocksdb-backend`). Key operations: `add`, `flush`, `delete_by_actor` (GDPR forget), `delete_by_id`, `purge_expired`, `set_status`, `corroborate`/`contradict` (confidence +/-0.10/0.15 with auto-quarantine), `update_record` (partial update with version increment), `search_semantic` (cosine similarity + keyword fallback + trust weighting + decay + priority multiplier + pinned record surfacing), `find_latest`, `audit_verify`, `embed_and_add`. Free functions: `cosine_similarity`, `keyword_score`.

nodes.label: aureus_bridge
nodes.summary: Reflexion / chain-of-thought module. `AureusBridge` orchestrates a Bayesian hypothesis-update loop: calls an LLM client, parses structured `ReflexionHypothesis` responses (text, confidence, evidence, supports/refutes), updates belief via Bayes rule (`update_belief(prior, likelihood)`), maintains a `HypothesesGraph`, prunes low-confidence hypotheses, and stores resulting hypotheses as `MemoryType::Reflexion` records. Intelligence hooks: `with_self_model` (health gate before reflexion), `with_world_model` (prediction used as Bayesian prior), `with_coherence` (entity consistency check post-hypothesis). Additional methods: `reflect_on_memory` (semantic search → context → reflexion pass), `run_monte_carlo` (N samples → dominant hypothesis by mean confidence), `top_hypotheses`, `reset_hypotheses`.

nodes.label: coherence/mod
nodes.summary: Cross-module consistency coordinator for the HipCortex intelligence layer. Four components: (1) CoherenceChecker — central coordinator running a background 60s check cycle, gates writes, exposes metrics; (2) ConsistencyChecker — detects 5 inconsistency types (TemporalSymbolicConflict, ProceduralWorldConflict, CausalInconsistency, EntityPermanenceViolation, BeliefSymbolicInconsistency); (3) ConflictResolver — 3 strategies (Consensus/majority vote, Recency/newest wins, Confidence/highest score wins) plus manual override; (4) SystemInvariants — enforces 4 mathematical invariants: Memory Consistency (temporal_count==symbolic_count, critical), Decay Monotonicity (activation non-increasing, non-critical), Graph Acyclicity (DAG enforcement, critical), Conservation (created-deleted==net_change, non-critical). State held via Arc<RwLock<>>; locking order must be respected. Critical invariant violations halt operations.
nodes.notes: 626 lines total. CoT block at top of file (canonical shape per CLAUDE.md). Arc<RwLock<>> shared state — deadlock risk if locking order not respected. Exposed via /coherence/* REST endpoints in web_server.

Stores (state, action, next_state) counts and (state, action) totals in HashMaps; predict computes smoothed posterior probabilities and Shannon entropy; update_with_system_id applies a boosted Bayesian update for high-surprise events (System-ID rewrite). Guarantees probability sums to 1.0 over the global vocabulary.

Tracks a prediction outcome history for calibration; propagate_uncertainty models covariance growth linearly with prediction steps.

Delegates to SafetyClassifier for semantic content classification; check_precondition blocks on Action::Block, flags non-Safe categories in violation_log, and supports a threshold override variant. Exposes audit_snapshot (JSON with timestamp + violations), rollback (logged), and a SAFETY_GUARDRAIL lazy_static Mutex singleton for global access.

Used to reduce high-dimensional embeddings for storage or comparison. No external dependencies.

nodes.name: SnapshotManager

Used by LoopEngine for transactional cycle snapshots of serialised topology graphs.

nodes.name: SourceTrustRegistry

SourceTrustProfile tracks per-source corroboration/contradiction counts and recomputes trust as alpha/(alpha+beta); trust decays exponentially for stale sources. SourceTrustRegistry is the HashMap-backed registry offering get_or_create, trust_weighted_score (geometric mean of confidence × trust), is_trusted threshold check, decay_all_stale, and admin override. nodes.name: extension.ts
nodes.summary:
Main VS Code extension entry point for HipCortex Memory. Implements the full extension lifecycle: activate/deactivate, auto-server management, LM tool registration, chat participant, and VS Code commands.

Key subsystems:

1. SERVER MANAGEMENT: HipCortexAPI.autoStartServer() resolves the server binary via a priority chain — bundled VSIX binary (server/<platform>/<name>), CLI install dir (~/.hipcortex/), user cache (~/.hipcortex-vscode/bin/), then GitHub Releases download. Uses an exclusive server.lock + hipcortex.pid file shared with the Python CLI daemon to prevent dual spawns. ensureUnixExecutable() applies chmod 0755 to bundled Mac/Linux binaries (or copies to writable cache on read-only installs). shouldReuseRunningServer() implements a semver major.minor accept policy (configurable strict mode).

2. REST API CLIENT (HipCortexAPI): Wraps the Rust web server at http://127.0.0.1:3030 (configurable). Endpoints covered: GET /health, POST /memory/add, GET /memory/query, GET /memory/live_beliefs, POST /memory/reflect, POST /worldmodel/predict, POST /worldmodel/rollout, GET /memory/search/related, POST /memory/search, POST /memory/link, GET /self/can-execute, GET /worldmodel/causal, POST /worldmodel/causal/counterfactual, POST /worldmodel/causal/intervention, GET /topo/ppr, POST /topo/deconstruct, POST /topo/apply-hyp, POST /topo/check-edge. Bearer token auth via hipcortex.apiKey setting.

3. LM TOOLS (vscode.lm.registerTool, VS Code 1.90+): 10 substrate-first tools for Copilot/agent harness:
   - hipcortex_search: live_beliefs + reflect; substrate-first recall gate
   - hipcortex_health: health summary + reflect loop
   - hipcortex_predict: world model state prediction with SelfModel can-execute gate
   - hipcortex_rollout: multi-step WM rollout (dirichlet / mcts modes, supports goal_state for UCB1)
   - hipcortex_graph_search: PPR-ranked related memories by seed UUID
   - hipcortex_causal: causal graph query (graph / counterfactual / intervention modes)
   - hipcortex_topo_ppr: Personalized PageRank over CausalTopoGraph nodes
   - hipcortex_deconstruct: parse hypothesis text into causal nodes/edges; apply=true writes to topo
   - hipcortex_check_edge: validate causal edge addition for cycles/reversals
   - hipcortex_can_execute: SelfModel gate for agent operations

4. CHAT PARTICIPANT (@hipcortex): HipCortexChatParticipant routes text commands — add/record/store, query/find, search, health/status, link, mode (headroom/caveman). Token savings tracked via TokenTracker and shown in status bar and chat footer.

5. AUTO-CAPTURE: onDidSaveTextDocument hook stores every file save as a Symbolic memory record. Enriches with extractSemanticTags() (5 layers: languageId, path hints, git branch slug, document symbols, error diagnostics) and WM prediction of next file edited.

6. VS CODE COMMANDS: hipcortex.addMemory (input box flow), hipcortex.queryMemory (QuickPick with formatMemoryQuickPickItem / formatMemoryDetailMessage), hipcortex.testExtension (health ping), hipcortex.restartServer.

7. UTILITY EXPORTS: buildPublishedBinaryName, sharedInstallDir, sharedDataDir, sharedPidPath, sharedLockPath, parseLockPid, shouldStealStaleLock, netstatLineMatchesListenPort, isValidServerBinary, ensureUnixExecutable, extractPortFromBaseUrl, parseHealthPayload, isServerVersionAcceptable, shouldReuseRunningServer, extractSemanticTags, formatMemoryQuickPickItem, formatMemoryDetailMessage.

Configuration settings consumed: hipcortex.apiUrl, hipcortex.apiKey, hipcortex.autoStart, hipcortex.strictServerVersion, hipcortex.optimizationMode (headroom|caveman).

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Master developer reference for the HipCortex Rust crate covering build and test commands for all feature combinations, the two-layer architecture (storage plus intelligence), subsystem responsibilities, module wiring and feature-gating conventions, testing layout, and embedded GitNexus code-intelligence rules for AI agents.

nodes.name: HipCortex Cohesive Gap Remediation Design
nodes.summary: Implemented 4-sprint design spec remediating critical architectural gaps in HipCortex against its S-Tuple Acceptance Criteria: Sprint 1 fixes silent math/API failures (Rollout API, causal SCM boundary, Kalman Joseph-form covariance, Merkle test correction); Sprint 2 introduces a polyglot CognitiveRecord<T> envelope and Hot/Cold tiered storage to prevent RAG search pollution; Sprint 3 adds provenance reachability tracing via a Cognitive Garbage Collector; Sprint 4 enforces the L0 Cognitive State Infrastructure boundary by extracting execution, consolidation, and planning logic to L4/L1/L2 layers.
nodes.languageNotes: References Rust-specific patterns (CognitiveRecord<T> generic envelope, Deref type aliases for backward compatibility, Joseph-form Kalman update) alongside Python test corrections; status field is IMPLEMENTED indicating all sprints were executed.

nodes.name: world_model_actor.rs
nodes.summary: Tokio actor wrapping WorldModelEnhanced for async message-passing: defines a WorldModelMessage enum covering all world-model operations and a WorldModelActorClient struct that sends typed messages over an mpsc channel and awaits oneshot responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Tokio mpsc + oneshot channel pattern (actor model): a background task owns the WorldModelEnhanced instance and processes messages sequentially, while callers hold only a cloneable sender handle — avoiding shared mutable state across async boundaries.

nodes.name: WorldModelMessage
nodes.summary: Enum defining the full message protocol for the world-model actor: nine variants covering action recording, state-transition observation, prediction, entity management, causal graph mutations, and counterfactual queries — each carrying its payload and an optional oneshot responder.

nodes.name: WorldModelActorClient
nodes.summary: Cloneable async client handle for the world-model actor: holds the mpsc sender and exposes ten typed async methods that construct messages, open oneshot channels for responses, and await results — providing a clean interface over the underlying actor loop.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WorldModelActorClient by creating an mpsc channel, spawning a Tokio task that owns a WorldModelEnhanced instance and dispatches incoming messages in a receive loop, then returning the client handle backed by the sender.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: HipCortex crate root that registers every public module via pub mod declarations (many with #[path] redirects into src/modules/), re-exports key types such as LoopEngine, ReactEngine, CausalTopoGraph, EdgeType, and InMemoryBackend, and applies feature flags to gate web-server, gRPC, async-store, GUI, RocksDB, and tokio-dependent surfaces. Recently extended with pub mod payloads, archive_store, cognitive_gc, and execution_gate, plus updated loop_engine re-exports.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust lib.rs uses #[path] to redirect module declarations to files under src/modules/ — adding a file there without a matching entry here leaves it invisible to the compiler. Feature-gated blocks (async-store, web-server, grpc-server, gui, rocksdb-backend, tokio) allow additive compilation without external dependencies on a clean machine.

nodes.name: memory_diff.rs
nodes.summary: Provides structural diffing between two slices of MemoryRecord snapshots, exposing FieldChange and StateDiff types plus compute_diff and diff_snapshots functions for tracking record-level mutations including confidence deltas, status transitions, and ReAct iteration counts.

nodes.name: FieldChange
nodes.summary: Value-object struct recording a single field mutation: field name, old value, and new value as strings.

nodes.name: StateDiff
nodes.summary: Aggregates all field-level changes between two versions of a MemoryRecord, including record ID, version bounds, collected FieldChange entries, confidence delta, status change, and ReAct iteration delta.

nodes.name: diff_snapshots
nodes.summary: Compares two slices of MemoryRecords to identify added and removed records by ID set membership, returning separate added/removed vectors.

nodes.name: compute_diff
nodes.summary: Produces a StateDiff between two MemoryRecord instances by comparing individual fields, computing confidence delta, detecting status transitions, and calculating ReAct iteration changes.

nodes.name: memory_record.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the canonical MemoryRecord struct and MemoryType enum that form the core data model of the engine, including SHA-256 integrity hashing, temporal decay, access tracking, metadata management, pruning heuristics, and provenance fields (evidence, derived_from, react_iteration) for agentic workflows.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses serde derive macros for JSON serialization and sha2/hex for integrity hashing. The new Goal/Skill/Belief MemoryType variants and provenance fields enable ReAct agent traceability.

nodes.name: MemoryType
nodes.summary: Enum discriminating memory record kinds: Temporal, Symbolic, Procedural, Reflexion, Perception, and the recently added Goal, Skill, and Belief variants for metacognitive agent state.

nodes.name: MemoryRecord
nodes.summary: Core memory record struct carrying identity (UUID), temporal metadata, actor/action/target triple, arbitrary JSON metadata, SHA-256 content hash for integrity, relevance score, confidence, priority/status/tag classification, and provenance fields evidence/derived_from/react_iteration.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructor that initializes a MemoryRecord with a fresh UUID, current timestamp, default relevance/confidence/priority/status, computes the SHA-256 integrity hash, and sets the content_hash field.

nodes.name: compute_hash
nodes.summary: Clones the record with hash fields zeroed, serializes to JSON bytes via serde_json, and returns a hex-encoded SHA-256 digest for integrity verification.

nodes.name: calculate_decay_factor
nodes.summary: Applies exponential time decay weighted by access frequency and current relevance score, returning a clamped 0-to-1 decay factor.

nodes.name: set_metadata_field
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a typed value in the JSON metadata map and recomputes the content hash and integrity hash to keep the record consistent.

nodes.name: should_prune
nodes.summary: Returns true when the record falls below an access-count threshold or exceeds a maximum age in days, enabling LRU-style pruning decisions.

nodes.name: similarity_score
nodes.summary: Computes a multi-dimensional similarity score against another MemoryRecord, combining actor/action/target string equality, metadata field overlap, tag intersection, and confidence proximity.

nodes.name: memory_store.rs
nodes.summary: The central persistence facade for MemoryRecord storage, providing pluggable backends (file JSONL, encrypted JSONL, in-memory, RocksDB), write-ahead buffering, inverted indices for actor/action/target lookup, trust-weighted semantic search with cosine similarity, namespace filtering, audit log integration, snapshot/rollback, and recently patched archive exclusion from default search results.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses IndexMap for ordered inverted indices and a VecDeque write-ahead buffer. The search_semantic method applies multi-factor ranking: cosine or keyword score x trust weight x priority multiplier x exponential time decay, with pinned records injected at the head.

nodes.name: MemoryStore
nodes.summary: Main store struct holding the pluggable backend, in-memory record vector, audit log, write-ahead buffer, inverted indices for actor/action/target, source trust registry, optional embedding provider, and optional namespace.

nodes.name: BulkAddError
nodes.summary: Error type for bulk-add operations, carrying the failing record index, actor name, and human-readable reason string.

nodes.name: new_with_options
nodes.summary: Constructs a MemoryStore backed by a JSONL file with optional zstd compression, initialising all indices, audit log, and WAL buffer before loading persisted records.

nodes.name: new_encrypted
nodes.summary: Creates an AES-GCM encrypted JSONL-backed MemoryStore, deriving a per-file key directly from the provided 32-byte key slice.

nodes.name: new_encrypted_envelope
nodes.summary: Opens or creates an envelope-encrypted MemoryStore where a master key wraps a randomly generated data-encryption key, supporting re-keying without re-encrypting all records.

nodes.name: new_in_memory
nodes.summary: Instantiates a non-persistent in-memory MemoryStore backed by InMemoryBackend with a no-op audit sink, useful for testing and ephemeral agent sessions.

nodes.name: new_rocksdb
nodes.summary: Constructs a MemoryStore using RocksDB as the backend for high-throughput persistent storage, requires the rocksdb feature flag.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Reads all records from the backend, rebuilds the actor/action/target inverted indices, and populates the in-memory record vector.

nodes.name: rebuild_indices
nodes.summary: Clears and reconstructs all three inverted index maps from the current in-memory record vector, used after mutations that change multiple records.

nodes.name: purge_expired
nodes.summary: Removes records whose expires_at timestamp has passed, rebuilds indices, and returns the count of purged records.

nodes.name: delete_by_id
nodes.summary: Removes the record with the given UUID from the in-memory vector and rebuilds indices, returning the count of deleted records.

nodes.name: add
nodes.summary: Appends a MemoryRecord to the in-memory store, updates all three inverted indices, appends to the audit log, buffers the record in the WAL, and flushes when the batch threshold is reached.

nodes.name: search_semantic
nodes.summary: Ranks non-archived, non-expired records by a composite score of cosine similarity (when embeddings present) or keyword overlap, multiplied by source trust, priority, and exponential time decay; pinned records are injected at the head regardless of score.

nodes.name: set_status
nodes.summary: Updates a record status string and recomputes its integrity hash, then rewrites the full backend to persist the change.

nodes.name: corroborate
nodes.summary: Increases a record confidence by 0.1 capped at 1.0, recomputes its hash, notifies the source trust registry, and persists the change.

nodes.name: contradict
nodes.summary: Decreases a record confidence by 0.15 floored at 0.0, moves its status to quarantine, notifies the source trust registry, and persists the change.

nodes.name: compute_decay
nodes.summary: Reads per-record decay_factor and decay_half_life_secs from metadata and computes an exponential decay multiplier based on elapsed time since creation.

nodes.name: find_by_actor_ns
nodes.summary: Returns records matching a given actor filtered to only those tagged with the store active namespace prefix.

nodes.name: namespace_counts
nodes.summary: Counts records per namespace by scanning all records for ns-prefixed tags and returning a HashMap of namespace to count.

nodes.name: find_trusted
nodes.summary: Filters records for a given actor to those whose source meets or exceeds a trust_threshold according to the source trust registry.

nodes.name: embed_and_add
nodes.summary: Calls the configured embedding provider to produce a float vector from the given text, stores it in the record metadata under the embedding key, then adds the record to the store.

nodes.name: delete_by_actor
nodes.summary: Removes all records belonging to a given actor, rebuilds indices, rewrites the backend, and appends an audit log entry for the deletion.

nodes.name: update_record
nodes.summary: Applies partial updates (target, action, confidence, source, metadata) to an existing record by ID, recomputes the hash, rewrites the backend, and logs the update to the audit trail.

nodes.name: find_latest
nodes.summary: Returns the most recent non-expired records matching optional actor/action filters, deduplicated by actor+action pair and limited to the requested count.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Flushes the WAL buffer then serializes the full in-memory record set to a JSON snapshot file at the given path.

nodes.name: rollback
nodes.summary: Restores the store state from a JSON snapshot file, verifying each record hash integrity before accepting it, then rebuilds indices, rewrites the backend, and logs the rollback event.

nodes.name: cosine_similarity
nodes.summary: Computes cosine similarity between two f64 embedding vectors, clamping to the shorter length and guarding against zero-magnitude vectors.

nodes.name: keyword_score
nodes.summary: Computes a keyword overlap score between a query string and a MemoryRecord actor/action/target fields, returning the fraction of query tokens found in the concatenated haystack.

nodes.name: loop_engine.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the cognitive omega-loop engine (`LoopEngine`) for Bayesian topology-guided self-mutation, and the `ReactEngine` for goal-driven ReAct-style iteration that writes Temporal observations and Reflexion critiques per cycle and terminates on GoalPayload success-factor satisfaction.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of topology PageRank for coverage gap detection and Dirichlet rollouts via WorldModelEnhanced; all mutations are gated by SafetyGuardrail::check_precondition and CoherenceChecker::gate_write before touching the causal graph.

nodes.name: LoopEngine
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the omega cognitive loop: snapshot → gap detection → strata rollout → surprise calculation → Bayesian attribution → tentative topology mutation → uncertainty propagation → belief update → trace distillation.

nodes.name: ReactEngine
nodes.summary: Goal-driven ReAct loop engine that iterates up to a configurable max, writing Temporal observations and Reflexion critiques per iteration, then resolves goal status (Succeeded/Failed) based on GoalPayload success factors.

nodes.name: run_omega_loop
nodes.summary: Executes one full omega cycle: snapshot → gap detection → world-model uncertainty → PageRank localization → rollout simulation → surprise → attribution → mutation → audit → belief/trace update.

nodes.name: simulate_rollouts
nodes.summary: Simulates future state trajectories using localized subgraph PageRank seeds and Dirichlet rollout, falling back to direct next-state prediction when rollout returns empty.

nodes.name: apply_tentative_mutation
nodes.summary: Applies a topology mutation conditioned on AttributionMap weights, guarded by SafetyGuardrail and CoherenceChecker, then propagates uncertainty and appends audit entries.

nodes.name: detect_coverage_gap
nodes.summary: Identifies topology coverage gaps via personalized PageRank; returns a StrataTrajectory with a coverage score and highlighted sparse-topology layers.

nodes.name: process_surprise_reflexion
nodes.summary: Records a state-action-outcome transition into the world model and runs the coherence gate to reject updates that would introduce paradoxes or safety violations.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: ReactEngine entry point: loads a GoalPayload from the memory store, iterates observe/reflect cycles writing MemoryRecords, checks success factors each iteration, and returns Succeeded or Failed status.

nodes.name: decision.rs
nodes.summary: Implements `DecisionEngine` using expected-utility maximization to approve or reject operation execution, now also implementing the `ExecutionGate` trait to allow injection as a pluggable gate into `SelfModel`.
nodes.languageNotes: Adaptive threshold uses EWMA of historical approval rate to tighten or relax the EU floor; the ExecutionGate trait impl delegates to the same evaluate() method, enabling decoupled polymorphic gating.

nodes.name: DecisionEngine
nodes.summary: Expected-utility decision engine with configurable thresholds, adaptive EU floor based on historical approval rate, validation feedback loop, and `ExecutionGate` trait implementation.

nodes.name: evaluate
nodes.summary: Core decision evaluation: computes expected utility then gates approval through cascading checks on success rate, resource usage, health score, and adaptive EU threshold, recording each decision in history.

nodes.name: compute_expected_utility
nodes.summary: Computes expected utility as a weighted combination of success rate, health score, resource efficiency, priority, deadline urgency, and cascading-impact penalty.

nodes.name: adaptive_threshold
nodes.summary: Adjusts the minimum expected-utility threshold based on historical approval rate: raises threshold if approval rate is too high, lowers it if too low, requiring at least 10 decisions to activate.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Self-model coordinator (`SelfModel`) aggregating capability registry, resource monitor, performance tracker, health aggregator, and decision engine; new `with_gate()` constructor injects an `ExecutionGate` override that short-circuits `can_execute` without touching the internal decision pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: All subsystem fields are wrapped in Arc<RwLock<...>> for concurrent access; the gate_override is Arc<Mutex<dyn ExecutionGate>> to support trait-object polymorphism across threads.

nodes.name: SelfModel
nodes.summary: Thread-safe coordinator that wires capability registry, resource monitor, EWMA performance tracker, health aggregator, and decision engine together; supports pluggable ExecutionGate injection via `with_gate()`.

nodes.name: can_execute
nodes.summary: Primary execution gate: if a gate_override is set, delegates immediately to it; otherwise queries capability, resources, performance, and health to feed the DecisionEngine and returns its Decision.

nodes.name: causal.rs
nodes.summary: Implements CausalGraph, a directed acyclic graph supporting do-calculus interventions, backdoor adjustment, SCM counterfactuals, and empirical distribution tracking. Recently extended with auto_populate_from_transitions() that seeds causal distributions from a Dirichlet transition model and an intervention_label field on InterventionQuery.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses HashMap-keyed empirical distributions keyed by string condition/outcome pairs; backdoor adjustment iterates cartesian products over confounder states computed at runtime.

nodes.name: CausalGraph
nodes.summary: Core DAG structure storing nodes, directed edges, edge strengths, and conditional distributions; exposes graph traversal (BFS path-finding, DFS all-paths, cycle detection) alongside causal inference methods (backdoor-adjusted intervention, SCM counterfactual, empirical intervention).

nodes.name: compute_intervention
nodes.summary: Applies the backdoor adjustment formula to estimate the causal effect of setting an intervention variable to a value on an outcome variable, summing over confounder states weighted by their prior probabilities.

nodes.name: auto_populate_from_transitions
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the causal graph empirical distributions from a Dirichlet-Multinomial transition model: adds state/action/next_state nodes and edges, computes a state prior from observation counts, and derives marginal next-state distributions via model.predict for each state-action pair.

nodes.name: compute_scm_counterfactual
nodes.summary: Performs structural causal model counterfactual inference: abduces noise terms from observed state, applies the intervention by fixing a variable, and re-predicts remaining variables in topological order using edge strengths.

nodes.name: entity.rs
nodes.summary: Implements EntityTracker, a Kalman filter for tracking entity state vectors over time, including anomaly detection via Mahalanobis distance. Extended with EntityConfig allowing a custom state-transition matrix F and a with_config constructor.
nodes.languageNotes: Matrix math (transpose, multiply, add, subtract, Gauss-Jordan inverse) is implemented inline without external linear algebra crates, keeping the minimal petgraph_backend build dependency-free.

nodes.name: EntityTracker
nodes.summary: Kalman filter tracker holding state mean vector, covariance matrix, transition/observation/noise matrices, and an anomaly list; supports multi-step prediction, Bayesian state updates, Mahalanobis anomaly scoring, and staleness checks.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Executes the Kalman filter update step: computes innovation residual, Kalman gain, updated state mean and covariance, detects anomalies via Mahalanobis distance, and applies Joseph-form covariance stabilization.

nodes.name: matrix_inverse
nodes.summary: Computes the inverse of a square matrix via Gauss-Jordan elimination with partial pivoting; returns Err for singular or non-square matrices.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Defines WorldModelEnhanced, the top-level coordinator for the enhanced world model: wraps a Dirichlet transition model, Kalman entity map, causal DAG, learned predictors, and uncertainty estimator all behind Arc<RwLock<...>>, and exposes transition observation, entity tracking, causal intervention, MCTS planning, and rollout methods. New sync_causal_distributions() bridges the transition model into the causal graph.
nodes.languageNotes: All subsystems are Arc<RwLock<T>>-wrapped for concurrent access; the consistent read/write-lock pattern across every method enforces a safe shared-state contract.

nodes.name: WorldModelEnhanced
nodes.summary: Facade class combining Dirichlet-Multinomial transition learning, Kalman entity tracking, causal graph inference, learned predictor ensemble, uncertainty quantification, and MCTS-based planning into a single concurrency-safe coordinator.

nodes.name: sync_causal_distributions
nodes.summary: Reads the current transition model and calls auto_populate_from_transitions on the causal graph, keeping empirical causal distributions in sync with observed state-action-nextstate counts.

nodes.name: mcts_best_action_goal
nodes.summary: Runs Monte Carlo Tree Search to select the best action from a root state toward a goal state, using UCB1 exploration and the Dirichlet transition model for simulated rollouts.

nodes.name: causal_intervention
nodes.summary: Public facade for causal intervention queries: normalises the intervention value, routes to empirical or structural computation on the causal graph, and fills in a default outcome if the graph returns empty.

nodes.name: rollout_dirichlet
nodes.summary: Simulates a multi-step trajectory through the Dirichlet transition model by greedily selecting the most probable next state at each step, returning the final state and joint confidence.

nodes.name: save
nodes.summary: Serialises the WorldModelEnhanced state (transitions, entities, causal edges) to a directory of JSON files for persistence.

nodes.name: load
nodes.summary: Deserialises WorldModelEnhanced from a directory of JSON files, reconstructing the transition model, entity trackers, and causal graph edges.

tour.title: Entry Point: Library Root
tour.description: Start with src/lib.rs — the module registry. Every subsystem is wired here via #[path] attributes. Understanding lib.rs tells you what exists and how modules map to file paths.

tour.title: Core Data Model: MemoryRecord
tour.description: MemoryRecord is the canonical record type. Learn MemoryType variants (Temporal/Symbolic/Procedural/Reflexion/Goal/Belief/Skill), provenance fields (derived_from, evidence), and the SHA-256 integrity hash.

tour.title: Persistence Layer: MemoryStore
tour.description: MemoryStore is the persistence facade — JSONL, AES-GCM encryption, WAL, Merkle audit log, tiered hot/cold storage. ArchiveStore handles cold records. Never write records by hand — always go through MemoryStore.

tour.title: Perception & Temporal Memory
tour.description: PerceptionAdapter ingests multimodal input (text, embeddings, vision). TemporalIndexer stores observations in a segmented ring buffer with decay and LRU pruning.

tour.title: Symbolic & Procedural Memory
tour.description: SymbolicStore is the knowledge graph (petgraph default, neo4j/postgres optional). ProceduralCache drives FSM-based skill traces with checkpoint save/load.

tour.title: Intelligence Layer: Self-Model
tour.description: SelfModel provides metacognitive awareness — capability registry, resource monitor (linear regression), performance tracker (EWMA + Bayesian), health aggregator, decision engine (expected utility). ExecutionGate allows custom override of can_execute().

tour.title: Intelligence Layer: World Model
tour.description: WorldModelEnhanced combines Dirichlet-Multinomial transition model, Kalman entity tracking, and a causal graph with do-calculus. sync_causal_distributions() bridges transition observations into the causal graph automatically.

tour.title: Intelligence Layer: Coherence
tour.description: CoherenceChecker + ConflictResolver ensure cross-module consistency. SystemInvariants enforces acyclicity, decay monotonicity, conservation. All shared state uses Arc<RwLock<...>> — respect locking order.

tour.title: Cognitive Runtime: ReAct Loop & GC
tour.description: ReactEngine drives goal-directed loops (GoalStatus Pending→InProgress→Succeeded/Failed), writing Temporal observations and Reflexion critiques per iteration. CognitiveGC manages provenance reachability — Archive if referenced, Delete if orphaned.

tour.title: API Surface & External Integrations
tour.description: REST (Axum web_server.rs), gRPC (Tonic grpc_server.rs), MCP (mcp_server.rs), VS Code extension (vscode-extension/), Python e2e harness (tests/e2e_user_harness/). All external mutations must pass SafetyGuardrail::check_precondition first.
